Path: changing a running app without code | platform-core.docs-audience-gate | P1

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `security` · `priority:p1` · `domain:cli` · `area:studio` · `pm:queue`

Triage: lands in `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` (`fetchAudienceBooks`, `:2721-2730`, and the `/meta/doc/:name` corpus read at `:7127`, both `.catch(() => [])`) ⇒ `domain:cli`; rationale: a thrown book read is read as "no book exists", so a permission-set-gated doc is served (200, with its body) to an authenticated non-holder — an authorization decision that fails OPEN on a store fault, against ADR-0046 §6.7 and the audience resolver's own fail-closed rule. Security ⇒ p1.

Triage seat #6015 · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T10:00Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card and its full thread, and `origin/main`.

Execution note: route both reads' fault to a deny, as the app-nav arm PR #20128 adds already does (`readAudienceBooks` / `readDocCorpus`); serial after PR #20128 (#19790) on the same file. Pin: a rejecting book read answers 403 for a gated doc and prunes it from the list.
